explanation: Layout-only rework of the tracker view: three primary filters plus a More filters panel declared once in trackerFilterDefs, removable active-filter chips with Clear all, empty status chips hidden, and one-line table rows with merged species/region and n columns and icon-only quality badges. DEFAULT_TRACKER_FILTERS moves into trackerLogic; firstN no longer keeps a list comma. Filtering, sorting, review state and routes are unchanged, so the module description stays accurate.
